name: file-lock
body: An exclusive OS file lock held by a process while it opens or mutates a shared resource. Two distinct locks are in play for a durable mutation: the apg-authored flock on `apg/.trans/specs.lock` (intended to serialize the read-modify-write sequence) and lbug's own exclusive lock on `apg/.trans/db.lbug`. A mutation attempt that takes only one of them races any other opener of the same DB — the failure the project must eliminate.
